start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:work-through-a-framework with framework 'Morning Routine Handbook' about my bakery pursuit: answer every question from what you already know about me and ask me only what you cannot tell."

lists.label: About me
lists.holds: What is known about the person, one row per framework question: the draft answer, whether the AI inferred it or the person confirmed it, how sure, and the evidence behind it.

values.question: What is the first thing you do when you wake up?
values.answer: Draft: you start the oven and read the order sheet before anything else.
values.evidence: Voice note on 2026-10-30: "first thing I do is start the oven and read the order sheet"
values.source: Example Author, Morning Routine Handbook, chapter 2

values.question: What would you stop doing if nobody noticed?
values.source: Example Author, Morning Routine Handbook, chapter 3

alike: a personal profile or bio note

instructions: 1. Have the framework as a private file in your files (items with their questions, exercises and source citations); run workflow:bring-in-a-framework first if you do not have one.

2. Pour the two example rows into the list you keep facts about yourself in (see pour), or let the run make list:about-me; say "Run workflow:work-through-a-framework" with framework and, when known, about.
3. Steps read and infer go through every item in order and answer from your own messages, recordings and files, each inferred answer with its quote, confidence and area; nothing is asked yet.
4. Step keep saves every answer as a row of About me (AI-inferred and person-confirmed stay apart); step ask shows you only the needs-you questions beside the AI's best draft.
5. Confirm, correct or leave each open; step use refreshes awareness from the confirmed rows and reports how many items were inferred, asked, confirmed, changed and left open.

worked_examples.title: One question is answered from a voice note, another is left for the person

The framework has items item-2 and item-3; a voice note from 2026-10-30 says "first thing I do is start the oven and read the order sheet"; nothing in the account says what the person would stop doing.

pour.how: Name the list you already keep for the same job and read it with records:read (its fields and row type). Run tool:pour-example-rows-into-my-list with that list as into and this kit list as kit_list: it matches each kit field to one of yours (your map, the same id, the same label, or a name in alike), pours nothing under 80% and names the fields with no home, and otherwise answers the one records:write that adds the example rows beside your own.
